name: Noble Families of the Feywood
description: The noble families of the Feywood — the elven houses whose multi-generational presence has shaped the Feywood's civic, ceremonial, and material life for millennia. Seven houses are the most prominent: Heartwood, Vaelaryn, Silverbough, Thornmere, Dawnveil, Greybranch, and Ironsap. Each carries a characteristic civic association — sacred stewardship, trade-diplomacy, wild-harvest, defensive vinework, ceremonial calendar, oral law, sanctioned craft. The houses are not aristocracy in the realm sense; they are continuous family lines whose accumulated knowledge, ceremonial exposure from childhood, and family-culture transmission produce candidates well- suited to specific civic work. Houses are overrepresented in their associated structures — at all levels and disproportionately at senior levels — through this mechanism, not through formal claim or inheritance. The Council of Elders includes representatives from these seven and from additional houses; the seven are the most notable, not the only ones.
